summary: Verified new per-user 'Notify' button on Admin > Users (Legacy) > UserDetail page. End-to-end flow works: button renders 4th in the action row with correct purple styling & bell icon; opens the shared NotificationComposer modal scoped to 1 recipient; confirm dialog fires with expected copy; POST /admin/users/notify sent {user_ids:[<uid>], message} and received 200 {ok:true, sent:1}; modal closes after send. Bulk-notify entry points and other UserDetail actions (Suspend/Grant tokens/Email user) remain intact — no regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 2557 lines — recommend splitting UserDetail, UsersList, NotificationComposer, EmailOfferComposer into separate files per the >700 LOC guideline (not blocking, but growing quickly).

Toast text extraction hit inlined CSS-in-JS <style> blocks with class name containing 'toast' — consider tightening the toast element data-testid so tests can assert the exact success message text ('Sent to 1 user(s)') without CSS false-positives.
